body:
## Pull request overview

This PR consolidates duplicate protocol definitions and adds architectural documentation to clarify the 3-layer sync architecture (Simple Sync → ETL → Enterprise Connector).

**Changes:**
- Removed duplicate UI component schema (`block.zod.ts` merged into `component.zod.ts`)
- Consolidated RLS definitions (removed `RLSRuleSchema` from `permission.zod.ts` in favor of canonical `RowLevelSecurityPolicySchema`)
- Created shared field mapping protocol (`shared/mapping.zod.ts`) with base schemas for field transformations
- Added architectural guidance to sync layer files (`sync.zod.ts`, `etl.zod.ts`, `connector.zod.ts`)
- Updated JSON schema generation and documentation files

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 42 out of 42 changed files in this pull request and generated 4 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/spec/src/ui/block.zod.ts | Deleted duplicate component schema (106 lines removed) |
| packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts | Updated export to use component.zod.ts instead of block.zod.ts |
| packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts | Updated comment reference from block.zod.ts to component.zod.ts |
| packages/spec/src/permission/permission.zod.ts | Removed embedded RLSRuleSchema, imported RowLevelSecurityPolicySchema from rls.zod.ts, renamed property from `rls` to `rowLevelSecurity` |
| packages/spec/src/shared/mapping.zod.ts | Created shared base field mapping protocol with TransformTypeSchema and FieldMappingSchema |
| packages/spec/src/shared/index.ts | Added export for new mapping.zod.ts |
| packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts | Extended BaseFieldMappingSchema from shared, added architectural guidance on when to use connectors vs other layers |
| packages/spec/src/data/external-lookup.zod.ts | Extended BaseFieldMappingSchema from shared for external lookup specific features |
| packages/spec/src/automation/sync.zod.ts | Imported FieldMappingSchema from shared, added architectural guidance on when to use simple sync |
| packages/spec/src/automation/etl.zod.ts | Added architectural guidance on when to use ETL pipelines |
| packages/spec/json-schema/* | Updated generated JSON schemas to reflect source schema changes (field renames, RLS consolidation, transform types) |
| content/docs/references/* | Updated documentation files to reflect schema changes, created new mapping documentation, removed obsolete files |
</details>

The PR description claims "Zero breaking changes" but this PR introduces several breaking changes:
1. Field mapping property names changed from `sourceField`/`targetField` to `source`/`target`
2. Permission set property changed from `rls` to `rowLevelSecurity`
3. `RLSRuleSchema` removed in favor of `RowLevelSecurityPolicySchema` with different field names (`objectName` → `object`, different operation enum values)

These are API-breaking changes that will require consumers to update their code. Consider either:
- Updating the PR description to acknowledge these as breaking changes
- Providing backward compatibility aliases or deprecation warnings
- Incrementing the major version number if using semantic versioning

The source file reference is incorrect. It claims the source is `packages/spec/src/integration/mapping.zod.ts`, but this file does not exist. The actual source is `packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts` where `FieldMappingSchema` is defined. Update the source reference to point to the correct file.
```suggestion
**Source:** `packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts`
```

The documented properties don't match the actual schema in `packages/spec/src/data/mapping.zod.ts`. The documentation shows properties like `type` and `readonly` which don't exist in the ETL FieldMappingSchema. The actual schema has `source`, `target`, `transform`, and `params`, not the base shared mapping properties. Either:
1. Update the documentation to match the actual ETL-specific FieldMappingSchema, or
2. Update data/mapping.zod.ts to use the shared FieldMappingSchema (but this would be a breaking change)
```suggestion
| **transform** | `object` | optional | Transformation configuration to apply to the source value before mapping |
| **params** | `object` | optional | Transformation parameters or options passed to the transform |
```
The example code in the JSDoc comment uses `rls:` but the actual schema property is `rowLevelSecurity`. The example should be updated to use the correct property name `rowLevelSecurity`.
